sources.claim: Most of Finland belonged to Sweden. In 1809 it became an autonomous Grand Duchy in the Russian Empire.
Equal suffrage including women was introduced in 1906, followed by elections in 1907. Finland declared independence on 6 December 1917.
Finland joined the European Union in 1995, long after becoming independent.
